reader_summary.overview: Eric Peters is the founder and CIO One River Asset Management. Eric made news in November when he executed a $600 million purchase of bitcoin, then the largest public transaction to date. He has called bitcoin the most interesting macro trade he's seen in thirty years in the business, and we kick off this mini series.
